dedupe_keys.name: powergen abm power plant expansion optimisation with techno economic input output and environmental analysis indonesia 2010 2025

description: PowerGen-ABM is an optimisation model of power plant expansion, applied to the Indonesian electricity system from 2010 to 2025. The CoMSES Net release read on 2026-09-28 (version 1.0.0, published 4 August 2019 by Al Irsyad, Halog, Nepal and Koesrindartoto) combines a techno-economic analysis based on the revenue requirement formula, linear programming of the expansion, input-output analysis of economy-wide effects, and an environmental analysis of the steel, concrete, aluminium and energy used and the carbon dioxide equivalent emitted in building and operating power plants. Despite its name, the release describes an optimisation, not a behavioural agent model, written in NetLogo. Coverage is Indonesia. Access is free download under the MIT licence. Caveats: the horizon ends in 2025 and input data are from the late 2010s, so they need updating. It supports capacity planning studies, such as comparing expansion paths by cost, material demand and emissions. Related record: ARISE by the same authors models household solar investment in Indonesia.
name: PowerGen-ABM: power plant expansion optimisation with techno-economic, input-output and environmental analysis (Indonesia 2010-2025)
outputs: costs, material use and CO2e emissions
provider: Muhammad Indra Al Irsyad, Anthony Halog, Rabindra Nepal and Deddy P. Koesrindartoto (CoMSES Net)
